name: Premium Stack Craft
description: Additive deterministic checks for the 2026 premium-website stack: curated motion/component libraries, WebGL/3D surfaces, smooth-scroll hygiene, and texture/detail craft that signal a high-value build.

ruleExtensions.instruction: The project must draw components from at least one curated premium library (21st.dev, Aceternity UI, Magic UI, ReactBits, or shadcn/ui) or implement equivalent bespoke components in the same style; copy-paste-only output with zero customization fails this check.

At least one depth surface must exist: WebGL/Three.js scene, R3F Canvas, shader background (shadcn shader, animated gradient mesh, or canvas shader), or layered 3D transforms; flat single-layer backgrounds are insufficient.
A smooth-scroll solution (Lenis, GSAP ScrollSmoother, or Locomotive Scroll) must be configured when scroll choreography is used, so scrolling feels weighted and continuous rather than stepped.

Texture craft must be present: subtle grain/noise overlay (CSS or SVG, animated or static), a signature accent color used sparingly for CTAs, or a branded cursor with hover states; none of these means the site reads as generic.

Performance hygiene must be enforced: canvas/WebGL renders inside requestAnimationFrame, scroll handlers are throttled or RAF-based, WebGL fallbacks exist for unsupported devices, and no animation forces layout thrash on scroll.

tierB.name: premiumCraft
tierB.condition: only scored when the premium-stack extension is enabled
tierB.instruction: Score whether the build reads as premium and high-value: curated library components integrated with brand coherence, depth and texture that feel intentional, buttery smooth scroll feel, physics-based micro-interactions (magnetic cursor/buttons, lerp easing, edge-only magnetism), and restraint so motion serves the message.
